name: Mad, Sad, Glad

steps.text: Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; emotion is a system signal.
Gather data (15m): silent notes in Mad, Sad, Glad; colour by column.
Generate insights (20m): read Mad, then Sad, then Glad; ask what conditions produced each.
Decide (15m): one Mad or Sad cause becomes one structural mitigation.
Close (5m): appreciations from the Glad column, each naming a person.

action: 'Mad about flaky staging' becomes isolate staging databases and script a nightly refresh; one owner, one date.
provenance: Source protocol: the phases and minutes follow the written sequence in the source.

origin.note: A common retro format; no documented originator.
